verdict.rationale: PayPal documents public REST APIs for orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, and disputes. The docs cover client-credentials OAuth, webhooks, a sandbox environment, and published OpenAPI specs for code generation, and Braintree adds a GraphQL API with an explorer. Probes confirm machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md REST pages) are live. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of driving the APIs end to end beyond first-party docs and doc-availability probes.
